# ── Setup ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, here, posterior, cmdstanr, bayesplot, patchwork)

pba_draws_list <- readRDS(here("models_fit_to_data", "pba_empirical_draws.rds"))
wba_draws_list <- readRDS(here("models_fit_to_data", "wba_empirical_draws.rds"))
```
# ── Helper functions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```{r}
extract_predictive_data <- function(draws, stan_data, participant_id, 
                                    target_var = "posterior_pred") {
  obs_df <- tibble(
    obs_id        = seq_len(stan_data$N),
    first_rating  = stan_data$first_rating,
    group_rating  = stan_data$group_rating,
    second_rating = stan_data$second_rating
  )
  pred_samples <- draws |>
    dplyr::select(-.chain, -.iteration) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols      = dplyr::starts_with(target_var),
      names_to  = "obs_id",
      values_to = "pred"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(obs_id = readr::parse_number(obs_id))
  obs_summary <- obs_df |>
    dplyr::group_by(first_rating, group_rating) |>
    dplyr::summarise(mean_obs = mean(second_rating), .groups = "drop")
  pred_samples |>
    dplyr::left_join(obs_df, by = "obs_id") |>
    dplyr::group_by(.draw, first_rating, group_rating) |>
    dplyr::summarise(mean_draw = mean(pred), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::group_by(first_rating, group_rating) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      mean_pred = median(mean_draw),
      lower     = quantile(mean_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      upper     = quantile(mean_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups   = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::left_join(obs_summary, by = c("first_rating", "group_rating")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(ID = participant_id)
}

generate_pba_prior <- function(stan_data, participant_id, n_draws = 500) {
  obs_df <- tibble(
    obs_id        = seq_len(stan_data$N),
    first_rating  = stan_data$first_rating,
    group_rating  = stan_data$group_rating,
    second_rating = stan_data$second_rating,
    total         = stan_data$total
  )
  p_prior  <- rbeta(n_draws, 1, 1)
  wf_prior <- p_prior
  wg_prior <- 1 - p_prior
  pred_samples <- expand_grid(.draw = 1:n_draws, obs_id = obs_df$obs_id) |>
    left_join(obs_df, by = "obs_id") |>
    mutate(
      wf         = wf_prior[.draw],
      wg         = wg_prior[.draw],
      alpha_post = pmax(0.01, 0.5 + wf * first_rating + wg * group_rating),
      beta_post  = pmax(0.01, 0.5 + wf * (total - first_rating) +
                          wg * (total - group_rating)),
      theta      = rbeta(n(), alpha_post, beta_post),
      theta      = pmin(pmax(theta, 0), 1),
      pred       = rbinom(n(), size = 7, prob = theta)
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(pred))
  obs_summary <- obs_df |>
    group_by(first_rating, group_rating) |>
    summarise(mean_obs = mean(second_rating), .groups = "drop")
  pred_samples |>
    group_by(.draw, first_rating, group_rating) |>
    summarise(mean_draw = mean(pred), .groups = "drop") |>
    group_by(first_rating, group_rating) |>
    summarise(
      mean_pred = median(mean_draw),
      lower     = quantile(mean_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      upper     = quantile(mean_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups   = "drop"
    ) |>
    left_join(obs_summary, by = c("first_rating", "group_rating")) |>
    mutate(ID = participant_id)
}

generate_wba_prior <- function(stan_data, participant_id, n_draws = 500) {
  obs_df <- tibble(
    obs_id        = seq_len(stan_data$N),
    first_rating  = stan_data$first_rating,
    group_rating  = stan_data$group_rating,
    second_rating = stan_data$second_rating,
    total         = stan_data$total
  )
  rho_prior   <- rbeta(n_draws, 2, 2)
  kappa_prior <- rlnorm(n_draws, log(2), 0.5)
  wf_prior    <- rho_prior * kappa_prior
  wg_prior    <- (1 - rho_prior) * kappa_prior
  pred_samples <- expand_grid(.draw = 1:n_draws, obs_id = obs_df$obs_id) |>
    left_join(obs_df, by = "obs_id") |>
    mutate(
      wf         = wf_prior[.draw],
      wg         = wg_prior[.draw],
      alpha_post = pmax(0.01, 0.5 + wf * first_rating + wg * group_rating),
      beta_post  = pmax(0.01, 0.5 + wf * (total - first_rating) +
                          wg * (total - group_rating)),
      theta      = rbeta(n(), alpha_post, beta_post),
      theta      = pmin(pmax(theta, 0), 1),
      pred       = rbinom(n(), size = 7, prob = theta)
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(pred))
  obs_summary <- obs_df |>
    group_by(first_rating, group_rating) |>
    summarise(mean_obs = mean(second_rating), .groups = "drop")
  pred_samples |>
    group_by(.draw, first_rating, group_rating) |>
    summarise(mean_draw = mean(pred), .groups = "drop") |>
    group_by(first_rating, group_rating) |>
    summarise(
      mean_pred = median(mean_draw),
      lower     = quantile(mean_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      upper     = quantile(mean_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups   = "drop"
    ) |>
    left_join(obs_summary, by = c("first_rating", "group_rating")) |>
    mutate(ID = participant_id)
}
```
# ── Generate predictions (run once) ───────────────────────────────────────────
```{r}
make_stan_data <- function(id) {
  participant_data <- transformed_data %>% filter(ID == id)
  list(
    N             = nrow(participant_data),
    first_rating  = participant_data$FirstRating,
    group_rating  = participant_data$GroupRating,
    second_rating = participant_data$SecondRating,
    total         = rep(7, nrow(participant_data))
  )
}

pba_prior_ppc <- imap_dfr(pba_draws_list, function(draws, id)
  generate_pba_prior(make_stan_data(id), participant_id = id))

wba_prior_ppc <- imap_dfr(wba_draws_list, function(draws, id)
  generate_wba_prior(make_stan_data(id), participant_id = id))

pba_post_ppc <- imap_dfr(pba_draws_list, function(draws, id)
  extract_predictive_data(draws, make_stan_data(id), participant_id = id))

wba_post_ppc <- imap_dfr(wba_draws_list, function(draws, id)
  extract_predictive_data(draws, make_stan_data(id), participant_id = id))
```
# ── Plot (edit rerunning generation) ──────────────────────────────────────────
```{r}
make_ppc_plot <- function(plot_data, title, subtitle) {
  ggplot(plot_data,
         aes(x = first_rating + 1, colour = factor(group_rating + 1),
             fill = factor(group_rating + 1))) +
    geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lower + 1, ymax = upper + 1),
                   position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
                   alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 2) +
    geom_line(aes(y = mean_pred + 1),
              position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
              linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(aes(y = mean_obs + 1),
               shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.8, size = 2,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:8, limits = c(1, 8)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:8, limits = c(0, 10)) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle,
         x = "First Rating", y = "Mean Second Rating",
         colour = "Group Rating", fill = "Group Rating") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.title     = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.key.size  = unit(0.4, "cm")
    )
}

p1 <- make_ppc_plot(pba_prior_ppc,  "PBA - Prior Predictive Check",     "Pooled across participants")
p2 <- make_ppc_plot(pba_post_ppc,   "PBA - Posterior Predictive Check", "Pooled across participants")
p3 <- make_ppc_plot(wba_prior_ppc,  "WBA - Prior Predictive Check",     "Pooled across participants")
p4 <- make_ppc_plot(wba_post_ppc,   "WBA - Posterior Predictive Check", "Pooled across participants")
```

# ── Refine and combine ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```{r}
make_combined_plot <- function(plot_data, title) {
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(check = factor(check, levels = c("Prior", "Posterior")))
  
  ggplot(plot_data,
         aes(x = first_rating + 1, 
             group = interaction(factor(group_rating + 1), check),
             colour = check, fill = check)) +
    geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lower + 1, ymax = upper + 1),
                   position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
                   alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 2) +
    geom_line(aes(y = mean_pred + 1, linetype = check),
              position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
              alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Prior" = "#c97b6e", "Posterior" = "#6e8fc9")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values   = c("Prior" = "#a86868", "Posterior" = "#5870a8")) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Prior" = "dashed", "Posterior" = "solid")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:8, limits = c(0.5, 8.5)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:8, limits = c(1, 8)) +
    labs(title   = NULL,
         x       = "First Rating",
         y       = "Mean Second Rating",
         colour  = NULL,
         fill    = NULL,
         linetype = NULL) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text     = element_text(size =6)
    )
}

p_pba <- make_combined_plot(pba_combined, "PBA - Prior vs Posterior Predictive Check")
p_wba <- make_combined_plot(wba_combined, "WBA - Prior vs Posterior Predictive Check")

p_pba
p_wba
```
